title: Tooth owed for fn-pck-adopt-is-the-catalog's decode conjunct: a must-fail with a WELL-FORMED catalog row that is an overflow row (fn-cat-rowp true, fn-cp-overflow-of true, e.g. a row whose remainder or numbers tree fn-sccb-treep refuses), so that fn-cat-rowsp holds and only fn-pck-carriedp fails; with a concrete witness that the decode differs from H. The current tooth (pckt-decode-uncarried) uses the non-row 7, which also breaks fn-cat-rowsp and does not isolate carriedp.
